hazards.description: The left side of the street features a long, continuous curb cut where vehicles can enter or exit the parking area at any point, crossing the pedestrian path unpredictably.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks, forcing pedestrians to cross mid-block without protection or priority.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no dedicated, paved walkway for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the roadway or through active parking areas.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Openings
hazards.description: The lack of defined curb cuts for the parking lot creates a large, uncontrolled area where vehicles can enter or exit at any point across the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: There are no designated or protected spaces for pedestrians to cross the roadway despite the presence of commercial destinations on both sides.

hazards.name: Frequent curb cuts

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer

hazards.name: Excessive Driveway Width

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Delineation
hazards.description: There is no marked path or physical separation for pedestrians through the large asphalt expanse of the parking lot entrance.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Vehicle Access
hazards.description: The large open asphalt area on the left allows vehicles to enter and exit the roadway at any point, creating unpredictable conflict zones.

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous, paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks at regular intervals or key desire lines to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Installation
interventions.description: Install vertical curbs to physically separate the roadway from the pedestrian realm and define the street edge.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a raised, continuous sidewalk across the gas station frontage to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Replace the continuous apron with defined, narrowed driveway entrances to reduce the area of conflict and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone between the roadway and the new sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Move utility poles to the edge of the sidewalk or into a new buffer zone to ensure a clear, accessible walking path.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cuts to the minimum required for safe vehicle access to better define the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Continuous Raised Sidewalk
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk at its original grade and material across the driveway to prioritize pedestrians and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Bollards or Planters
interventions.description: Install physical barriers between the sidewalk and the gas station lot to prevent vehicles from encroaching on the pedestrian path outside of designated access points.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility 'continental' striping to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Formal Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the left side of the street to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width and number of vehicle access points to minimize conflict zones between pedestrians and cars.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Curb Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks with raised curbs to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island at the intersection to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to prevent parking too close to potential crossing points and to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and visible space for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add street trees or a planting strip to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Install Continuous Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, raised, and ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a safe pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes and install curbs to slow traffic and provide space for a pedestrian buffer or bike lanes.

interventions.title: Access Management
interventions.description: Install curbs and defined driveway entrances to the parking areas on the left to limit vehicle conflict points.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety after dark.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to provide a more robust physical buffer and improve the aesthetic quality of the walk.

interventions.title: Active Frontage Improvements
interventions.description: Encourage the use of murals or windows on the blank wall to increase visual interest and engagement with the street.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk and Curbing
interventions.description: Install a raised sidewalk with a standard curb to provide physical protection and a clear boundary for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Street Trees
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Protection
interventions.description: Install bollards or street furniture to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width to meet ADA standards and repair cracked, uneven pavement surfaces.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Bollards
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone or bollards to physically separate pedestrians from traffic and prevent vehicle encroachment on the walkway.

interventions.title: Clear Path Enforcement
interventions.description: Enforce regulations against storing commercial goods like tires on the public sidewalk to maintain a clear path of travel.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and relocate utility poles to the furniture zone to ensure a clear, ADA-compliant path.

interventions.title: New Buffered Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a new sidewalk on the right side of the street with a landscape buffer to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Definition
interventions.description: Use curbs and landscaping to define a specific, narrow entrance to the parking lot, reducing the area of conflict between vehicles and pedestrians.
